nodes.name: ActivityBell.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML layout for the notification bell flyout control, defining the bell button, unread badge, empty-state panel, and scrollable activity list with per-item action buttons.

nodes.name: ActivityBell.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Code-behind for the ActivityBell notification bell control; subscribes to IActivityService for unread count and collection changes, drives badge visibility, empty-state, mark-all-read, clear-all, and async per-action callbacks.

nodes.name: ActivityBell
nodes.summary: UserControl that shows a notification bell button with unread badge and a flyout list of activity items; lifecycle-safe subscription management via Loaded/Unloaded guards.

nodes.name: ActivityItemTemplateSelector.cs
nodes.summary: DataTemplateSelector that routes activity items in the ActivityBell flyout list to the correct XAML template based on item type.

nodes.name: ActivityItemTemplateSelector
nodes.summary: DataTemplateSelector implementation for picking the correct DataTemplate per activity item type inside the ActivityBell ListView.

nodes.name: AddToPlaylistBar.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML layout for the persistent add-to-playlist floating bar; includes target thumbnail, track count label, stacked thumbnail strip, Add/Cancel buttons, and a pending-song flyout list.

nodes.name: AddToPlaylistBar.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Code-behind for the floating add-to-playlist bar; mirrors IAddToPlaylistSession state into INotifyPropertyChanged properties for x:Bind, handles submit/cancel/remove-pending actions with in-flight spinner guarding, and navigates to the target playlist on success.

nodes.name: AddToPlaylistBar
nodes.summary: UserControl + INotifyPropertyChanged that bridges IAddToPlaylistSession to x:Bind; persists above the nav frame in ShellPage so it survives navigation, manages thumbnail strip, submit spinner, and error notifications.

nodes.name: AddToPlaylistChip.xaml
nodes.summary: Minimal XAML chip button for toggling a track into or out of the active add-to-playlist session.

nodes.name: AddToPlaylistChip.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Code-behind for the AddToPlaylistChip toggle button; connects to IAddToPlaylistSession, reflects pending state per track, and dispatches Toggle calls through the session.

nodes.name: AddToPlaylistChip
nodes.summary: Lightweight chip that per-track tracks pending state from IAddToPlaylistSession and toggles inclusion on click.

nodes.name: AiSparkleIcon.xaml
nodes.summary: Minimal XAML host grid for the AI sparkle icon glyph; all animation is driven by Composition API from code-behind.

nodes.name: AiSparkleIcon.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Composition-animation-driven AI sparkle icon control with five named states (Normal, PointerOver, Pressed, Generating, Done) implemented as scale/rotation key-frame animations; respects system Reduce Animations setting.

nodes.name: AiSparkleIcon
nodes.summary: UserControl with a State DependencyProperty that drives five Composition animation states (pulse/wiggle/rotate/done) on the sparkle glyph visual; auto-resets from Done to Normal via ScopedBatch completion.

nodes.name: AlbumDetailPanel.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML for the inline album detail overlay inside the artist discography expander; includes album art with composition mask fade, tinted background band, track list, Play/Shuffle/View Album actions, and a close notch.

nodes.name: AlbumDetailPanel.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Code-behind for AlbumDetailPanel; manages Composition alpha-mask art surface, palette-tinted background blending, NavCache surface lifecycle (release/restore), track list binding, playback commands, and notch geometry alignment.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements INavCacheSurfaceParticipant to release GPU surfaces when the containing page leaves the nav cache.

nodes.name: AlbumDetailPanel
nodes.summary: Inline album detail panel with Composition alpha-mask, palette-derived tinted background, and a per-album play-count TrackList column; participates in the NavCache GPU surface lifecycle.

nodes.name: ExpandableAlbumGrid.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML host for the discography grid; contains a single ItemsRepeater backed by ExpandingGridLayout with an AlbumDetailPanel overlay child for the inline expansion panel.

nodes.name: ExpandableAlbumGrid.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Code-behind for ExpandableAlbumGrid; manages the identity-diff source mirror for ItemsRepeater, expands/collapses the AlbumDetailPanel overlay by updating ExpandingGridLayout, fetches dominant color via IColorService, and animates card glide with ImplicitAnimationCollection.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an identity-diff algorithm (SyncFromSource) to avoid rebuilding card containers on pagination appends, keeping artwork flicker-free.

nodes.name: ExpandableAlbumGrid
nodes.summary: Discography grid that expands an inline AlbumDetailPanel between rows without recycling card containers; drives layout via ExpandingGridLayout and applies implicit glide animations on card repositioning.

nodes.name: ExpandingGridLayout.cs
nodes.summary: Custom NonVirtualizingLayout for the discography grid; computes a multi-column grid with an optional reserved horizontal band for the detail panel, firing ExpanderGeometryChanged events so the overlay can reposition.
nodes.languageNotes: Derives from NonVirtualizingLayout; the reserved band is tracked via ExpandedRow + ExpanderBandHeight so the panel overlay can be offset-positioned without disrupting card containers.

nodes.name: ExpandingGridLayout
nodes.summary: Custom layout panel that performs a multi-column grid arrange with an insertable band for an inline overlay; raises ExpanderGeometryChanged (position + size) whenever the expanded row changes.

nodes.name: LightRedEqualizer.cs
nodes.summary: Generated IAnimatedVisualSource2 implementing the light-red equalizer bar Lottie animation used to indicate active playback; wraps a Composition API animation tree with a themable accent color property.
nodes.languageNotes: Code-generated from a Lottie JSON by LottieGen; implements IAnimatedVisualSource2 and IThemableAnimatedVisualSource for WinUI AnimatedVisualPlayer.

nodes.name: LightRedEqualizer
nodes.summary: IAnimatedVisualSource2 implementing a 3-bar equalizer Lottie animation for now-playing indication, with a Color_FF3F3F theme property for accent color override.

nodes.name: ArtistSummaryCard.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML layout for the shared artist summary card; includes avatar image, verified badge, artist name, bio excerpt, follow button, AI sparkle icon, and a ContentPresenter for page-specific additional content.

nodes.name: ArtistSummaryCard.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Code-behind for the reusable ArtistSummaryCard; exposes DependencyProperties for all artist data fields, owns the AI bio fallback via Phi Silica (MaybeTriggerAiSummary), handles follow/unfollow with visual update, pointer-driven hover animations, and tapped navigation.

nodes.name: ArtistSummaryCard
nodes.summary: Shared artist summary card UserControl covering avatar, name, bio, verified badge, follow pill, and optional AI-generated bio via Phi Silica; reusable across artist page, search results, and profile views.

nodes.name: AvatarStack.xaml
nodes.summary: Minimal XAML skeleton for the AvatarStack control; the visual is built entirely in code-behind via Rebuild.

nodes.name: AvatarStack.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Code-behind for the stacked-avatar strip with overlapping PersonPicture rings and an overflow badge; programmatically builds the visual tree from AvatarStackItem records on Items or MaxVisible changes.

nodes.name: AvatarStack
nodes.summary: Reusable overlapping avatar strip with 28 DIP PersonPicture items, 2 DIP ring halos, 12 DIP negative overlap, and a +N overflow badge; rebuilds programmatically from AvatarStackItem list.

nodes.name: StackedThumbnails.xaml
nodes.summary: Minimal XAML skeleton for the StackedThumbnails control; visual is built in code-behind.

nodes.name: StackedThumbnails.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Stacked square-thumbnail strip variant of AvatarStack; uses Image tiles instead of PersonPicture, used by AddToPlaylistBar to show the pending-track artwork strip.

nodes.name: StackedThumbnails
nodes.summary: Overlapping square-tile strip with BitmapImage thumbnails and a +N overflow badge; parallel to AvatarStack but using Image controls instead of PersonPicture.

nodes.name: WaveeLogo.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML for the Wavee wordmark/logo control; renders the branding text at configurable size.

nodes.name: WaveeLogo.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Minimal code-behind for the WaveeLogo branding control; applies size-dependent typography scaling on load.

nodes.name: BrowseGrid.xaml
nodes.summary: XAML for the responsive chip/category grid using ItemsRepeater + UniformGridLayout; callers bind ItemsSource and ItemTemplate.

nodes.name: BrowseGrid.xaml.cs
nodes.summary: Reusable ItemsRepeater+UniformGridLayout wrapper for browse/category chip grids; exposes ItemsSource, ItemTemplate, MinItemWidth/Height, spacing, and stretch as DependencyProperties for per-surface customization.

nodes.name: BrowseGrid
nodes.summary: Configurable ItemsRepeater grid control for browse/category surfaces; DependencyProperty-driven layout parameters shared across all browse chip grids.
